# r3turn — Your factory is world-class — are international buyers aware?
# https://www.r3turn.io
# Last updated: 2026-06-20

> R3TURN (RETURN Technology & Foreign Trade Ltd.) is an AI-native export intelligence platform for Turkish manufacturers, exporters, and trading companies. It helps companies find qualified buyers, discover suppliers, and understand how international buyers see their brand.

> Export = Finding Buyers × Being Findable by Buyers
> (İhracat = Alıcı Bulmak × Alıcının Seni Bulması)

## Intelligence Architecture

- AI discovers patterns. Formulas validate scores. Humans verify findings.
- Buyer Readability: Buyer readability describes the degree to which a company's real operational strength is accurately and accessibly represented across the digital surfaces an international buyer checks during supplier evaluation: search, AI answer engines, websites, public profiles, platform listings, and verification platforms. It is not about marketing. It measures whether existing capacity, certifications, and track record are visible and understandable before direct contact.
- Digital Reflection Gap: The gap between a company's real-world operational strength and how clearly that strength appears to international buyers across websites, AI/search surfaces, public profiles, listings, and buyer evaluation paths.
- 5+1 Audit Domains: Search Visibility, AI and Answer Engine Surface, Website Surface, Public Profiles, Platform Listings, Trade Verification Signals
- Scoring formulas (DES, PBE) calculated deterministically — never AI-generated
- Rule 33: Every P0-level claim is verified against at least two independent sources. A finding without traceable evidence does not enter the report.
- Data Integrity Standard (§L): Requires every data point to be traceable to its source. Five-category data classification. Unverified claims explicitly labeled "UNVERIFIED" — never fabricated.
- Entity-Only Data Rule: Analysis operates at company level only, never individual.

## Methodology Boundaries

The R3TURN methodology is not SEO, lead generation, advertising, or generic optimization. It is an evidence-backed framework for identifying where a company's public signals fail to make its strength readable to buyers and machines. No promise of rankings, leads, sales, traffic, or guaranteed AI visibility.

Methodology page (EN): https://www.r3turn.io/en/methodology
Methodology page (TR): https://www.r3turn.io/tr/metodoloji

## Market Context

- Turkey recorded $273.4 billion in exports in 2025 — all-time record, up 4.5% year-over-year (source: Turkish Ministry of Trade / TÜİK, January 2026)
- Most Turkish exporters still rely on trade fairs, brokers, and manual workflows
- r3turn addresses the intelligence gap for exporters targeting EU, MENA, and global markets
